text:
By Dhani Joseph ,
1 days ago
The regular season of Georgia high school basketball is officially over. That means postseason hoops is finally upon us.
GHSA-wide competition begins on Feb. 24. The first, second and quarterfinal rounds are hosted by the higher seed in the matchup. Round 1 is Feb. 24-25, round two Feb. 27-28 and the quarterfinals March 3-4.
Semifinals this year are held at a number of neutral sites. Classes 5A and 6A will be at Georgia State University in Atlanta. Classes 4A and Private play at Akins Arena in Athens. Classes 2A and 3A will duke it out at Legacy Arena in Douglasville. And Classes 1A-D1 and D2 will be at Fort Valley State University in Fort Valley.
For the teams that make it to their respective classes championship games, they'll play at the Macon Centreplex, located at 200 Coliseum Drive in Macon, Ga.. Those games will take place from March 11-14.
The schedule for those days is as follows:
Wednesday, March 111:00 p.m.: Private Girls3:00: Private Boys4:45: Boy's 3-Point Contest5:30: 3A Girls7:30: 3A Boys
Thursday, March 121:00 p.m.: 1A-Division 2 Girls3:00: 1A-Division 2 Boys4:45: Girl's 3-Point Contest5:30: 4A Girls7:30: 4A Boys
Friday, March 131:00 p.m.: 1A-Division 1 Girls3:00: 1A-Division 1 Boys4:45: Co-Ed 3-Point Contest5:30: 5A Girls7:30: 5A Boys
Saturday, March 1411:00 a.m.: 2A Girls1:00 p.m.: 2A Boys3:00: American Association of Adapted Sports Programs (AAASP) Varsity Wheelchair4:45: Slam Dunk Contest5:30: 6A Girls7:30: 6A Boys
Butler boys come into the postseason as defending Class 2A champions and are looking to win back-to-back titles. The Bulldogs, along with Cross Creek boys and Josey girls were the three Augusta-area teams to capture region championships this season.
GIAA postseason play began on Feb. 17 and are already in the semifinals. Westminster girls and Augusta Prep boys fell in the second round to Lakeview and the Heritage School respectively. The full GIAA brackets can be seen here .
